eligibility.evidence: Abstract, Sec 3.2: human participants (n about 2,165) rated predefined responses of a pseudo-LLM varied in modality and grammatical person; no model is the experimental subject and no cognitive paradigm is administered to a model (E1, E2, E3).

A.title: Believing Anthropomorphism: Examining the Role of Anthropomorphic Cues on Trust in Large Language Models

G.notes: Human-subject HCI experiment on trust in a scripted pseudo-LLM; no LLM is tested. Abstract states n=2,165, Sec 3.1 heading says n=2,170, which a referee would query. Not a candidate for the review.
